methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 dust-collection products a 2026 workshop buyer actually cross-shops: single-stage bag collectors (JET DC-1100VX-CK, Powermatic PM1300TX-CK, Shop Fox W1685, Delta 50-786, WEN DC1300, Harbor Freight/Central Machinery 97869), canister-filter collectors (Grizzly G0548ZP, Baileigh DC-600C), premium HEPA cyclones (Laguna P|Flux:1, Oneida Dust Gorilla Pro 5HP), a wall-mounted unit (RIKON 60-101), and a cyclone pre-separator accessory (Oneida Dust Deputy 2.5) that buyers routinely research alongside full collectors. Seed list was corrected on two points: 'Nova DC-1100' does not exist as a real product (no Nova/Teknatool dust collector of any kind could be found; search results only surfaced the unrelated JET DC-1100, so the seed was dropped rather than fabricated) and Grizzly's seed model 'G0548ZP' is confirmed as the current model (the older G0548Z with pleated bag filter is discontinued; ZP is the aluminum-impeller/canister successor Grizzly actively sells today). 'Rikon 60-101' was verified as the wall-mounted variant (distinct from the freestanding 60-100) and kept as named. Specs were pulled from manufacturer pages where fetchable (jettools.com, powermatic.com, rikontools.com, lagunatools.com) and from reseller/dealer pages plus Harbor Freight's own coupon-flyer subdomain where the manufacturer/retail site (grizzly.com, oneida-air.com, harborfreight.com's rendered product page, amazon.com, homedepot.com, lowes.com) blocked automated fetching (HTTP 403/429/404) — in those cases the cited source URL is the actual manufacturer/retailer page whose content was corroborated via search-index snippets or a working mirror, and this is flagged per-product in 'provenance'. Gallon-based collection capacities were converted to cu ft at 0.133681 ft3/gal. Oneida Dust Deputy 2.5 is a passive cyclone pre-separator with no motor or filter media of its own, so airflow/static-pressure/HP/micron/noise are legitimately null (it relies on the buyer's own shop vacuum) rather than estimated. Oneida Dust Gorilla Pro's CFM/static-pressure/noise are also left null because Oneida does not publish single fixed figures for that system (real-world airflow depends on the buyer's duct run) — null was preferred over a guessed number throughout. accessedAt 2026-08-01 for all entries.

products.name: JET DC-1100VX-CK Dust Collector
products.priceNote: Current jettools.com listed price (site's own 'savings event' pricing); no separate un-discounted MSRP was found
products.provenance: Verified directly on jettools.com official product page: 1100 CFM @ 4in, 10-1/2in static pressure, Vortex Cone single-stage design, 2-micron canister (5-micron bag version also sold as DC-1100VX-5M), 1.5HP 115/230V motor, 5.3 cu ft bag capacity, 6in primary port splitting to two 4in, 70-80dB (midpoint 75 recorded), $989.99 list.

products.name: Powermatic PM1300TX-CK TurboCone Dust Collector
products.priceNote: powermatic.com regular list price; frequently discounted to ~$1,199
products.provenance: Verified on powermatic.com: TurboCone chip separation, 1300 CFM filtered air, 1.75HP 115/230V motor, 2-micron canister capturing up to 98% of fine particles, dual 4in dust ports, 10 cu ft collection bag, digital timer with IR remote, $1,407 list / $1,199 promo. Static pressure (11.31in) sourced from Rockler's spec table, which mirrors Powermatic's own published sheet; noise level is not disclosed by Powermatic for this model. Image omitted: the only product photo found (jpwindustries.com CDN) is served from an extensionless transform URL rather than a direct .jpg/.png/.webp file, so it was not included.

products.name: Laguna P|Flux:1 Dust Collector
products.provenance: Verified on lagunatools.com: 1314 CFM maximum/nominal rating (manufacturer's own copy notes ~900 CFM in real shop conditions), 10.1in max static pressure, 1.5HP motor, HEPA filter cartridge rated 99.97% at 0.3 micron, 25-gallon LED-illuminated drum (converted to 3.34 cu ft), 6in primary inlet with 4in splitter, 70dB at 9.8ft, auto-cleaning cyclone, remote control, $3,499. Image omitted: the product-page image URL returned by the fetch was filenamed for the P|Flux:3 model, so it could not be confirmed as depicting the P|Flux:1 unit and was left out rather than risk a mismatched photo.

products.name: Grizzly G0548ZP 2 HP Canister Dust Collector
products.priceNote: Authorized-dealer price (factoryauthorizedoutlet.com, maxtool.com both list $979); grizzly.com blocks automated page fetches so its own listed price could not be confirmed directly. Other dealers (ustooldepot.com $755, Home Depot $849) list lower.
products.provenance: Corrects seed model 'G0548ZP' as spelled but flags that the plain G0548Z (pleated-bag, no aluminum impeller) it's sometimes confused with is discontinued — ZP is the current model Grizzly actively sells. Verified specs: 1700 CFM, 10in max static pressure, 2HP 240V single-phase, 12-3/4in aluminum radial-fin impeller, 1-micron spun-bond-polyester canister filter, 4.5 cu ft collection bag, heavy-duty steel adapter for three 4in lines, 83-85dB (midpoint 84 recorded). grizzly.com itself returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; specs corroborated via its search-indexed content.

products.name: RIKON 60-101 Wall-Mounted Dust Collector
products.priceNote: Walmart/Sylvane retail price; rikontools.com does not publish a price on its own product page
products.provenance: Confirmed as the wall-mounted model named in the seed (distinct from the freestanding RIKON 60-100). Verified on rikontools.com: 1HP TEFC motor (120/240V, 7A/3.5A, 3450 RPM), 10in aluminum spiral impeller, 1-micron pleated canister with internal flapper, 1.5 cu ft disposable debris bag, dual 4in or single 5in inlet options (1,100 CFM at 5in / 800 CFM at 4in — higher figure recorded). Static pressure and noise are not published by RIKON for this model. No price is listed on the manufacturer page; figure taken from Walmart/Sylvane retail listings.

products.name: Shop Fox W1685 1-1/2 HP Dust Collector
products.priceNote: grizzly.com regular list price (confirmed via search index; direct fetch blocked), frequently on sale ~$479. jbtools.com currently lists $836.93.
products.provenance: Verified via jbtools.com dealer spec sheet (mirrors grizzly.com, which returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch): 1280 CFM, 10.1in max static pressure, 1.5HP 110V single-phase 16A motor at 3450 RPM, 6in inlet with removable Y-fitting to two 4in openings, 2.5-micron bag filtration, 5.4 cu ft bag capacity. Noise (80-85dB, midpoint 82.5 recorded) sourced from an earlier aggregated retailer spec table consistent across multiple listings.

products.name: Oneida Dust Deputy 2.5 Deluxe Kit (5-Gallon)
products.priceNote: woodcraft.com listed price for the 5-gallon Deluxe Kit; the bare DIY cyclone body is $54.95 and the hose-only Plus kit (no bucket) is $79.95

specs.filter_type: none — cyclone pre-separator, no filter media (pairs with the buyer's own wet/dry vacuum)

products.provenance: The Dust Deputy 2.5 is a passive two-stage cyclone pre-separator, not a powered standalone collector — it removes >99% of dust/debris by mass before air reaches the buyer's own shop vacuum, so it has no motor, filter media, or independent CFM/static-pressure/HP rating of its own; Oneida publishes only a minimum-recommended-vacuum-airflow guideline (~50 CFM), not a cyclone CFM figure, so those spec fields are left null rather than guessed. Verified 2.5in nominal inlet/outlet (2.29-2.31in actual ID), 5-gallon bucket (converted to 0.67 cu ft), introduced per a 2022-03-30 FineWoodworking product announcement.

products.name: Delta 50-786 Dust Collector
products.priceNote: 2010 manufacturer suggested retail price at launch; this is a legacy model (still tracked by industrial-equipment listing sites such as MachineTools.com) and current 2026 US retail availability/pricing could not be confirmed
products.provenance: Oldest model in the set; the fullest verifiable spec source found is a dated (August 2010) ProToolReviews product preview: 1,200 CFM max air velocity, 1-micron disposable bag filtration rated 97% capture, 1.5HP motor, sheet-metal frame (vs. 'laundry cart' designs), two clear disposable bags, 5-year warranty, $429 suggested retail. Static pressure, exact bag capacity, inlet diameter and noise level were never published in any source found and are recorded as null rather than estimated.

products.name: Baileigh DC-600C Cyclone Dust Collector
products.priceNote: ctpowertools.com listed price; baileigh.com and most authorized dealers show 'call for pricing' rather than a public number
products.provenance: Verified via authorized-dealer spec sheet: 604 CFM, 1.5HP 110V single-phase motor (notable for running 1.5HP on 110V), 1-micron canister filter with manual clean-out, 20-gallon drum (converted to 2.67 cu ft), 6in primary inlet splitting to two 4in ports, 75dB at 3 meters, four locking swivel casters, 1-year parts warranty with lifetime phone support. Static pressure not published in any source found.

products.name: WEN DC1300 Dust Collector
products.priceNote: Typical US street price across retailers; ranges roughly $310-$392 depending on promo (Home Depot list ~$391.80, sale price ~$341.80)
products.provenance: wenproducts.com rate-limited every automated fetch attempt (HTTP 429) and Home Depot/Lowe's/Northern Tool returned HTTP 403; specs are corroborated identically across all of those listings, which independently cite the same manufacturer figures: 14A motor drawing up to 1,300 CFM, dual 4in inlets, 10in high-speed steel impeller at 3450 RPM, 50-gallon vertical collection bag (converted to 6.68 cu ft), 5-micron filtration, mobile base with four casters. WEN does not publish a horsepower figure for this model (only amperage), so motor_power_hp is left null rather than estimated; static pressure and noise level were not found published anywhere. Image omitted — no direct image file URL could be confirmed given the fetch blocks on every retailer checked.

products.name: Central Machinery 70-Gallon 2 HP Dust Collector (Item 97869)
products.priceNote: Recurring Harbor Freight coupon/sale price (documented flyers 2021-2023 ranged $179.99-$249.99); the live item page did not render product content for automated price confirmation on the access date
products.provenance: harborfreight.com's main item page did not return renderable product content to the automated fetch tool (only site navigation), so specs and price were confirmed instead via Harbor Freight's own coupon-flyer subdomain (go.harborfreight.com), which states the same figures verbatim across multiple dated 2021-2023 flyers: 2HP 120V 20A motor, 1,550 CFM airflow, 70-gallon tank (converted to 9.36 cu ft), 5-micron upper filter bag over a translucent lower collection bag, four locking swivel casters. Inlet diameter and noise level were not found published in any source checked. Image omitted — no direct image file URL could be confirmed.

products.name: Oneida Dust Gorilla Pro 5HP (55-Gal Freestanding, SMART Boost)
products.priceNote: oneida-air.com listed price for the 230V single-phase, 55-gallon freestanding SMART Boost kit

specs.filter_type: HEPA-grade media, SMART Boost cyclone separator

products.provenance: oneida-air.com returned HTTP 403 to every automated fetch attempt on this and every other Oneida product URL tried, so this entry relies on the same official URL's search-engine-indexed content rather than a directly rendered page — flagged here for transparency rather than silently presented as a clean fetch. Confirmed: industrial 230V U.S.-made 5HP fan motor, high-efficiency cyclone separator (>99% fine-dust removal by Oneida's own claim), 55-gallon dust bin with quick-release lid and automatic fill indicator (converted to 7.35 cu ft), HEPA-grade media filter with non-stick membrane, patented SMART Boost airflow-doubling technology for long duct runs, $4,899. Oneida does not publish a single CFM/static-pressure/noise figure for this system because real-world airflow depends on the buyer's ducting — recorded null rather than guessed.
